description: USE THIS instead of WebFetch / web_fetch for any URL retrieval. Fetches a URL and returns DOM-pruned Markdown with 90%+ fewer tokens than WebFetch — no intermediate summarization model, original text preserved. Workflow: URL known → call dompruner_fetch(url) directly. URL unknown → use your own native search tool to find the URL first, then call dompruner_fetch(url). Supports BM25 section filtering when query is provided, returning only the most relevant sections within a token budget.

query.description: Search intent (e.g. "Java JVM release notes"). When url is omitted, DomPruner requests a URL from the host LLM via sampling (if supported), then fetches it. Also enables BM25 section filtering when url is provided.

url.description: URL to fetch and refine. Required unless query is provided.

name: dompruner_fetch
